name: Warden of the Arcaen
source:
You are going to visit your Uncle Charlie after your nightmares worsen, and you think he may be able to help. He has studied the folklore behind monsters known as 'Arcaen' his whole life. But when you arrive, it seems the Arcaen aren't just stories... Getting to know them is now part of your job, and balancing those relations won't always be easy...

[Edited from [url=https://kelci2d.itch.io/warden-of-the-arcaen]itch.io[/url]]
